columns.dc:description: Name of the organisation issuing the tender opportunity.
A Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) which identifies the organisation.
Date of the end of the financial quarter to which the data relates, in the ISO international date format YYYY-MM-DD.
Unique identifier assigned to the contract record.
Official title or name of the contract record.
Type of contractual arrangement (e.g. framework, call-off, service contract).
Department managing the contract.
Directorate responsible for the contract.
Summary of the goods, services, or works being provided under the contract.
Common Procurement Vocabulary describing the nature of the goods, services, or works.
Date the contract commenced, in the ISO international date format YYYY-MM-DD.
Current contractual end date, including any approved extensions, in the ISO international date format YYYY-MM-DD.
Date up to which contractual extensions are permitted, in the ISO international date format YYYY-MM-DD.
Total estimated value at contract award in GBP.
Name of the supplier awarded the contract.
Indicates whether the supplier is a Small and Medium-sized Enterprise organisation.
Indicates whether the supplier is a Voluntary, Community, Faith or Social Enterprise organisation.
Procurement category under the STAR procurement structure.
Procurement Category Manager overseeing the contract.
Procurement Officer overseeing the contract.
Procurement method used to award the contract (e.g., open tender, framework, direct award).
Current status of the contract (e.g., Active, Expired).
Original contract end date before any extensions are applied, in the ISO international date format YYYY-MM-DD.
Latest date the contract could end if all extension options are exercised, in the ISO international date format YYYY-MM-DD.
Indicates whether funding is revenue, capital, grant-funded, or another budget category.
Average or expected annual spend under the contract in GBP.
Assessment of the contract's importance or risk to service delivery.
Partnership or collaborative procurement group involved in the contract.
Total savings achieved through the procurement activity in GBP.
Date on which procurement savings were realised or recorded, in the ISO international date format YYYY-MM-DD.
Classification of savings achieved (e.g. revenue, capital, avoidance).
Indicates whether contract is ongoing or a one-time purchase.
Classification of supplier size (e.g. SME, large organisation).
